# `message_content` attributes

| Key | Type | Description | Examples | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="message-content-audio"></a>`message_content.audio` | flattened object of `audio.*` | The audio content of the message, if the type is `"audio"`. Nested leaves are `audio.url` and `audio.transcript`. | `{"audio.url": "https://example.com/audio.mp3"}` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-data"></a>`message_content.data` | string | Opaque vendor-issued data captured verbatim. Maps to Anthropic `redacted_thinking.data`. | `EmwKAhgBEgy3...` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-document"></a>`message_content.document` | flattened object of `document.*` | The document content of the message (e.g. a PDF, an uploaded file, or inline text), if the type is `"document"`. Nested leaves are `document.url`, `document.content`, `document.mime_type`, `document.id`, and `document.name`. | `{"document.url": "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0...", "document.mime_type": "application/pdf"}` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-encrypted-content"></a>`message_content.encrypted_content` | string | OpenAI `encrypted_content` captured verbatim. | `gAAAAA...==` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-id"></a>`message_content.id` | string | Provider-assigned identifier for this message content item. For OpenAI Responses reasoning items, this maps to `ResponseReasoningItem.id` and should be preserved for stateless replay. | `rs_abc123` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-image"></a>`message_content.image` | flattened object of `image.*` | The image content of the message, if the type is `"image"`. | `{"image.url": "https://sample-link-to-image.jpg"}` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-signature"></a>`message_content.signature` | string | Opaque vendor-issued signature captured verbatim. Maps to provider `signature` fields, and to Gemini `thoughtSignature` fields when the signature is attached to a non-tool content part such as text. | `EuYBCkQYAiJA...` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-text"></a>`message_content.text` | string | The text content of the message. Used when `message_content.type` is `"text"` or `"reasoning"` (visible reasoning or summary text). For OpenAI `summary_text` arrays, concatenate the array items into this single text value for now. | `This is a sample text` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-type"></a>`message_content.type` | string (well-known values) | The type of the content. Use `"reasoning"` for reasoning/thinking content, including Anthropic `redacted_thinking` blocks. Use `"tool_use"` when a provider returns a tool call as an ordered content part. | `text`, `image`, `audio`, `video`, `document`, `reasoning`, `tool_use` | Development |
| <a id="message-content-video"></a>`message_content.video` | flattened object of `video.*` | The video content of the message, if the type is `"video"`. The nested leaf is `video.url`. Consumers infer MIME type from the URL path extension or a data URI prefix. | `{"video.url": "gs://bucket/clip.mp4"}` | Development |

## `message_content.type` values

`message_content.type` has the following well-known values. If one of them applies, it MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | Text content. |
| `image` | Image content. |
| `audio` | Audio content. |
| `video` | Video content. |
| `document` | Document content, e.g. a PDF, an uploaded file, or inline text. |
| `reasoning` | Reasoning or thinking content, including redacted reasoning. |
| `tool_use` | A tool call returned as an ordered content part. |
